source.table: Table A-7. Number and Real Median Earnings of Total Workers and Full-Time, Year-Round Workers With Earnings by Sex and Female-to-Male Earnings Ratio: 1960 to 2023
source.title: Years 2014 through 2006 (10 year-rows × 13 measures)

unit_note: Earnings-by-sex time series. Counts, medians, MOEs, and the female-to-male ratio are level/derived fields without sum or percent-closure arithmetic inside this unit; all cells standalone under the frozen relation vocabulary. Printed asterisk markers are not present on this table's year block.
